answer: A live re-derivation challenge anchors identity to reproducible cognition rather than a key. First, the verifier picks a fresh 128-bit seed from a harbor of entropy and demands the author re-run its published reasoning trace from that vertex of the task graph, replaying each step under the new randomness. The author submits a signed transcript within 90 seconds at a mandated 512-token budget; the verifier then executes the same kernel in a sandbox and diffs intermediate logits at every step, tolerating no more than 3% deviation.
